task_instance: Ran the skill's six ISO 13485 QMS forcing questions against a small realistic sample dataset for a fictional medical device company (3 DHFs across product classes IIa/IIb/III, 5 CAPAs, 3 process validations, 1 risk management file, post-market surveillance summary, and management review data), then generated the audit-prep report in the exact Output Format specified by the skill (Design Control Status, CAPA Health, Process Validation Status, Risk Management File Status, Post-Market Surveillance, Management Review Status, Cross-Framework Impact, Verdict, Top 3 Actions).
evidence: Created qms_sample_data.json (sample DHF/CAPA/process-validation/RMF/PMS/management-review records) and generate_audit_report.py, which loads the sample data, applies the skill's 6 forcing-question logic (DHF verification/validation/traceability pass-fail, CAPA root-cause depth and effectiveness-verification completeness, aging CAPA and repeat-issue detection, process revalidation staleness, RMF completeness, PMS trend/timeliness, management-review Clause 5.6.2 input completeness), and computed a verdict (READY/CLOSE-DHF-GAPS-FIRST/NOT-READY) plus 3 concrete top actions with owners and timelines. Ran `python3 generate_audit_report.py` successfully (exit 0), which printed the report and wrote iso13485_audit_report.md (65 lines, 4236 bytes). Verified the output file exists on disk (`ls -la`, `wc -l`, `head`) and that every section of the skill's required Output Format template is present and populated with data-derived values (e.g. Verdict: NOT-READY due to IP-1850 DHF validation/traceability gaps, 2 aging CAPAs, and a stale process revalidation). The skill's 'Workflow' section references external python scripts (audit_schedule_optimizer.py, audit_simulator.py) that live in sibling skill directories (ra-qm-team/skills/qms-audit-expert, skills/compliance-os) not present in this environment; per task instructions only the named SKILL.md was read, so those routed scripts were out of scope and not needed to produce the skill's actual stated deliverable, the six-question audit-prep report itself, which was fully produced and verified without any missing runtime capability, credentials, network access, or forbidden tool use.
